author_reference.author: Aswath Damodaran
author_reference.title: Ups and Downs: Valuing Cyclical and Commodity Companies
author_reference.support: Stable reinvestment rate g/ROC and the next-period after-tax operating-income valuation numerator; this function decomposes that numerator only.

calculation.project_adaptation: Explicit zero growth with positive NOPAT and positive ROC extends only the algebraic domain of g/ROC; the cited positive author examples do not establish zero-growth economic applicability. Strict metadata, isolated Decimal arithmetic and unresolved adoption remain local API rules.

limitations: Input labels, period equality and source/quote references are caller declarations, not independently verified documents, tax treatment, annual/52/53-week comparability, next-period timing or economic applicability.

NOPAT_next is supplied as after-tax operating income before financing; no tax/NOL calculation, (1+g) multiplication, historical ROC selection, WACC substitution or pretax-profit conversion is performed.

Explicit zero growth gives reinvestment rate and modeled reinvestment amount zero, and FCFF equal to the supplied next-period NOPAT. This does not establish zero gross capex or maintenance spending, a normalized forecast, or economic applicability; ROC=0 remains an undefined denominator.
Reinvestment rates above one and negative FCFF are retained without clamping; capital funding, growth sustainability and survival remain unverified.
No capex/D&A/working-capital parts, financing cash flows, DCF, terminal value, stock price, IR action or probability is generated, and intermediate arithmetic does not adopt a normalized forecast.
